description.value: Soul Bite Food is a Coquitlam-based social enterprise producing award-winning plant-based comfort food inspired by Eastern European and Middle Eastern traditions — think crispy phyllo pastries filled with Balkan mushroom-leek or smoked eggplant and walnut cheese. The company donates 51% of its profits to fighting hunger and food waste globally through the Food Link Society. Products are available for takeout at the Coquitlam facility and distributed through grocery retailers across four provinces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Soul Bite Food is a real, operating social enterprise producing vegan comfort food at 107-17 Fawcett Rd, Coquitlam — not North Vancouver as the OSM community field states (V3K 6V2 is a Coquitlam postal code, and the website explicitly says Coquitlam). The site's navigation includes a 'take out' link, and the OSM tag diet:vegan=yes is strongly corroborated by the website's consistent all-vegan product line. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the address (V3K 6V2, 107-17 Fawcett Rd) is in Coquitlam — confirmed by website. OSM community tag should be corrected to Coquitlam.
OSM fixme tag: 'location is approximate' — coordinates may not precisely locate the unit.
Business model is primarily retail distribution to grocery stores; the on-site takeout offering may be limited or by appointment. The 'take out' page was not fully scraped so details are uncertain.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business with confirmed address, phone, and active website. Offers takeout of all-vegan products, making it a useful stop for plant-based touring cyclists.
